description: Use when you need a wallet balance, token balances or the ERC20 balance of an address on Base, read live from the chain. Do not use for ethereum mainnet or other chains, NFTs, transaction history or USD values. Returns JSON with the wallet balance of an address on Base: ETH and ERC20 token balances read on-chain in one block, 21 major tokens plus any you list for 0.004 USDC per call. Typical response time 1200 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.004 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

includeZero.description: Also list tokens with zero balance (false when omitted)

tokens.description: Extra ERC20 token addresses on Base to check, e.g. ["0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"] (up to 20, beyond the 21 major ones)
